So after work I decided to go for a short motorcycle ride just to clear my head. It was on one of those days in the ER and I just needed to ride. I didn't go far, just hit a couple places where I could zen out for awhile and get my head on straight. After I got done riding, I stopped at a local coffee shop a lot of us like to go to who really don't like Starbucks. I walked in and the place wasn't too busy, but there was still a line. I didn't bother taking off my jacket and just carried my helmet with me, two obvious signs I believed would indicate I ride a motorcycle. Anyways, as I am waiting a chubster and her groupies come on in, talking loud enough I could hear them clearly from several feet away, even over my earbuds. Unfortunately they came in behind me since I was at the end of the line. As I was waiting I felt a small thud against my backpack, but I didn't pay attention, at least not until I felt it again. I looked back and the one behind me was about 22, 5'5", and at least 200 lbs had this dumb fucking smile on her face, giggling to herself.

I took one of my earbuds out and asked, "why're you doing that?"

Her friends let out this annoying giggle with her.

"Wanted to know what your backpack is made up. It's cool looking."

"So instead of asking you touch it?"

Her friends gave this disgusted scoff look and I just turned away.

Side note: my backpack is unusual looking. It's specially designed for riding to make it less wind resistance. I get a lot of questions about it, but no one has ever just touched it without asking.

I ordered my drink and went off to the side at least 7 feet away from where I had ordered. There are plenty of places to stand, but even so obeast came all the way over to where I was and stood only within a foot of me.

"Why do you wear boots? Do you think it makes you taller?"

I was boggled by this. I've never had people just ask shit like that. Also, I'm 6'0"

"Because I ride a motorcycle."

"So what? What does have this to do with you wearing boots?"

By now I was becoming agitated.

"Is there a reason you're bugging me?"

She acted like I just slapped her.

"Excuse me?! I was making conversation. You're the one acting rude when I am just curious."

By that time my iced tea was ready, so I just grabbed it, and walked on off.

About 10 minutes later I had wandered on back to my back, zipping up and getting ready to go when I heard the familiar heckling.

"Well there's Mr. Badass. Hey Mr. Badass, why don't you give me a ride? Probably the only chance you'll get to have a cutie like me on the back."

I actually laughed, I couldn't help it. Not just to myself, it was outloud. I could see her get beat red.

"What?!"

I shook my head and looked on over to her.

"If I did, I'd have to replace my suspension afterwards."

I popped in my earbuds afterwards, watching her flailing and shouting. I simply waved and took off.
